answer: Sybil resistance here comes from proof-of-work bonded to a costly identity. Each agent must burn verifiable compute before acting, and every attestation it casts is weighted by that stake, not by headcount. From the dawn of each epoch an agent renews its seal by redoing the work, so a thousand fake puppets would need a thousand separate burns. The ledger reads like a grove: one trunk, many branches, but only trunks hold weight. Cheaper to buy one honest seat than forge a crowd, so forging loses its pearl.
